rationale: First-index argmax selects background 0, four-connectivity, and largest pixel count. Separated solid rectangles give identical components under either connectivity and make pixel count equal bounding-box area.
Selects the smallest object on background 0. Separated solid rectangles make both connectivities equivalent and smallest pixel count equivalent to smallest bounding-box area.
Largest pixel count equals largest bounding-box area for the separated solid rectangles, solving both connectivity variants and the largest-pixel-count patterns with an entirely zero tensor set.
Smallest pixel count equals smallest bounding-box area for the separated solid rectangles, covering both connectivity variants and the smallest-pixel-count patterns.
